description: This file defines the TSProjectConsumer class responsible for processing configuration scripts related to Tuner Studio files, reading and writing specific sections, and integrating with other parts of the configuration system.

classes.name: TSProjectConsumer
classes.description: A class that processes and writes Tuner Studio configuration files, managing reading input files, parsing specific sections, and writing updated configuration files.

methods.name: writeTunerStudioFile
methods.description: Reads a template Tuner Studio file, inserts configuration data, and writes the output file.

methods.name: readTsFile
methods.description: Reads a Tuner Studio input file and separates it into prefix and postfix sections based on start/end tags.

methods.name: startFile
methods.description: Initialization method invoked at the start of file processing (empty in this implementation).

methods.name: endFile
methods.description: Completes file processing by writing the final configuration file.

methods.name: handleEndStruct
methods.description: Handles the end of a configuration structure, computes the total size, and registers it.
